subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Students learned that food carries geography and culture.”?
options: A stone from another world can make people look up.
Nature-based protection may look messy, but it can work with forces that hard structures only resist.
Sometimes a mistake can become an idea if people are willing to look at it differently.
What seems normal on one plate may look surprising on another, but each meal has a reason.
